desc: NewsNation is the US cable network that made the legacy program a standing beat rather than an occasional segment. It hired Ross Coulthart as senior special investigations correspondent, built Reality Check around him with a credited production and research team, and in 2026 ran a multi-part series with the pseudonymous researcher UAP Gerb that put FFRDCs, UARCs and GOCOs, gatekeeping, and the question of whether the legacy program constitutes a 'deep state' into broadcast segments. Its editorial posture on this subject is not neutral - it published a segment headlined 'Ross Coulthart on UAP Gerb's claims: I think he's on the money' - and that partisanship is precisely what allowed the structural argument to reach a mass broadcast audience when no other network would carry it.
